items.title: Handbook (intro): Purpose of the handbook
items.when: Orientation only.

items.title: Handbook Part 1: The Cordis mental model
items.when: Before writing your first plugin or when Cordis terms (Context, Fiber, Service, effect) are unclear.

items.title: Handbook Part 2: Theory translated into engineering
items.when: Only when you need the WHY behind effects/disposers/LIFO cleanup. Skip for routine plugin work.

items.title: Handbook Part 3: The actual Cordis runtime (Context API)
items.when: Using ctx.extend/isolate/intercept, or unsure what ctx really exposes.

items.title: Handbook Part 4: Plugins and Fibers
items.when: Choosing a plugin shape (function/object/class), ctx.plugin(), Fiber states (PENDING is not an error), Registry.

items.title: Handbook Part 5: Effects: the lifecycle discipline
items.when: Any timer, subscription, listener, or resource that outlives one apply() call.

items.title: Handbook Part 6: Services and live dependency injection
items.when: ctx.provide / inject, required vs optional deps, provider replacement, three-role capability seams.

items.title: Handbook Part 7: Events
items.when: ctx.emit / on and the dispatch modes (parallel, serial, bail, waterfall), typed events.

items.title: Handbook Part 8: Plugin configuration
items.when: Config schemas (Schemastery), validation failure, config update/HMR.

items.title: Handbook Part 9: cordis.yml, Loader, reconciliation, HMR
items.when: Only for real ACRYL/DSH composition via cordis.yml. Not used by mount_plugin.

items.title: Handbook Part 10: DeepSeek Harness: Cordis as an agent runtime
items.when: Understanding how Harness layers agent services on Cordis.

items.title: Handbook Part 11: Tools: from plugin to model-callable capability

items.title: Handbook Part 12: LLM adapters
items.when: Implementing an llm service / provider adapter (stream/StreamChunk contract).

items.title: Handbook Part 13: End-to-end hands-on Cordis mini-system
items.when: A worked, multi-plugin build from scratch. Read before building anything multi-file.

items.title: Handbook Part 16: Coding-agent decision framework
